verdict_text: YES — the script casts exactly the 48 named projection matrices to bfloat16 via `matrix_re`, leaves everything else float32 (embeddings, norms, biases unchanged), drops the 12 `attn.bias` buffers via `buffer_re`, preserves all tensor names, and asserts the four required checks (48 bf16 count, `c_attn.weight` bf16, `wte.weight` fp32, 148 total tensors) before writing. The sharder packs tensors greedily by byte size against the 64 MiB cap and correctly isolates an oversized tensor (e.g. `wte.weight`) alone in its own shard, writing a valid `model.safetensors.index.json` with a complete `weight_map`.
